name: Project Gutenberg
body: Every ebook page has its own title, description, and share card, and pages pass Core Web Vitals for real visitors. But no page read carries JSON-LD, so nothing tells search or AI which pages are books.
lesson: Add Book JSON-LD to each title page: name, author, inLanguage, and url. AI answers cite what they can parse.
summary: www.gutenberg.org scores 78 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 26 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: other sites can frame the page.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /donate/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
